_comment: Parameters for the OCR memory backfill (ocr-memory-backfill skill). CREDENTIALS never go here: they are passed through environment variables, see references/connection.md. These are the defaults; the CLI flags of scan_and_plan.py override them case by case.

invoice_domain._comment: Which invoices from the history are read as the learning source to derive the aliases.

scan._comment: Default scope of the skill: vendor bills WITH an attachment from the LAST YEAR. only_with_attachments=true (disable with --no-attachment-filter); default_window_months=12 -> when neither --since nor --limit is given, it filters from 12 months ago (--months N to change the window, --all-history for the whole history). limit_default = number of most recent invoices (0 = no additional limit).

audit._comment: In the audit, the number of distinct general accounts per supplier above which the classification is flagged as scattered.

thresholds._comment: Anti-noise: the most frequent destination (the mode) is seeded only if its support >= min_support and its consistency (mode/total) >= consistency; everything else is discarded to skipped.csv. 'tax' is an opt-in layer (generic names, lower value).

context_key_format._comment: INVARIANTS of the dynapps stack, confirmed in the code: TWO context_key formats, do NOT unify them. {pid} = id of the invoice's supplier; an empty string = a global alias.

_name_max_len_comment: ai.memory.alias truncates 'name' to 128 chars; the seeding mirrors that so the seeded text matches the mapping's lookup.
